text: Fixing #6512/#6515/#6528 (CSV/DELIMITED whitespace + header case): real VFP9 probe (retained ~/temp/vfp9-probes/csv-whitespace-6512) shows unquoted Character fields keep LEADING whitespace on import (' Alice', tab-led), outside-enclosure whitespace is dropped, exports keep leading whitespace and trim trailing padding, and the CSV header is lower-cased (NAME -> name).
